briefing.text: On News, Information Technology stays first (buzz 82.4, -0.1 on the day, -5.3 on the week, mentions -5%, sentiment 0.08), led by NVDA, MSFT, AMD. Energy climbed from 10th to 7th (buzz 75.2, +6.2; mentions +33%; sentiment 0.36) on FANG, CVX and KMI, and Materials gained 4.5 buzz points with mentions up 56% (AQI, CCJ, NEM). Financials fell on the week (buzz 64.8, -14.1 over 7 days) even with mentions up 22%. On X, Information Technology is first (buzz 93.0, NVDA, MU, AMD) and Communication Services moved from 4th to 2nd (NBIS, GOOGL, META). On Reddit, Health Care rose from 8th to 6th (buzz 86.1, mentions +36%, SLS, NVO, LLY) and Real Estate from 10th to 8th (mentions +80%), while Information Technology kept first with mentions down 12%.

KDP #1: only an analyst-consensus 'Moderate Buy' item; it does not explain the jump from #48, which comes from attention and X mentions.
DPZ #3: an analyst-upgrade roundup was the only positive item; the rank rests more on X attention and the November foot-traffic market.
PDD #5: an article on Temu's parcel duty and margins versus JD.com; earnings on 11-19 add to the attention.
PM #7: a fund holdings increase and a piece on higher rates testing dividend defensives; mild, not a clear driver.
ALK #8: 7 articles, mixed (one positive, one negative), including a dip below the 50-day average; they add some attention.
HD #10: 17 articles, mostly the Q3 earnings preview due 11-17; this does explain the rank.
DIS #11: reports of planned job cuts under the new CEO ahead of 11-17 earnings; this explains the rank.
UAL #12: a multi-day airline disruption after an FAA router failure, 3 negative articles; it explains the rank but UAL fell from #6.

KDP leads (score 0.956, up from #48) on attention 1.49 and X attention 2.18 versus normal, both near the top percentile, with volume 1.17 and a 0.93-sigma move. KLAR is second (0.949, up from #39): X attention 1.96, a 3.26-sigma move (+8.7% in 24h) and earnings on 11-17. DPZ is third (0.862, down from #1): attention 0.89 and X attention 1.20, a 1.37-sigma move, but volume only 0.15 versus normal, and a KPI market resolving as the catalyst.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
